questions: What is feedback?
If feedback turns positive, does the response necessarily get better?
What is a leak?
If the leak gets bigger, does the level always fall faster?
What is transit?
If transit speeds up, does less get taken in?
What is resistance?
If resistance doubles, does flow always halve?
What is recovery?
After recovery, is the system exactly as it was before?
What is gain?
If the gain is turned up, does everything just get louder?
What is contraction?
If the contraction gets stronger, does the whole thing necessarily get smaller?
What is capacity?
If capacity is reduced, does that mean it cannot keep up?
What is output?
If output rises, does that mean the system is doing better?
What is fatigue?
After fatigue, does rest always restore full performance?
What is firing?
After firing, can it still do its job?
What is reserve?
If the reserve is used up, is there nothing left?
What is compliance?
If compliance falls, does that mean someone is refusing to cooperate?
What is work?
If work increases, does that mean more gets finished?
What is charge?
If the charge runs out, does it stop working?
